explication: Browserbase Skills is a Claude Code plugin: users request browser automation or research, Claude applies a task-specific skill, and scripts or agent workflows produce browser results, traces, reports, or generated artifacts. The principal analysis path is browser automation → trace capture → trace analysis → an OpenAPI specification. The README documents the broader skill capabilities; the sampled sources show selected implementations and helpers, so unsampled capabilities are represented at their existing skill-directory paths.
